items.title: Tier boundary + consumer sub-typing + dispatch modes
items.scope: Define tier-1 in-scope artifact set (incl. commands/*.md), exclude tiers 2/3, split tier-1 into three consumer kinds, and classify agent dispatch modes (mapping 11 / workflow 7 / dual 1 / platform-flow 4)

items.title: L1 parse-reliability principles

items.risk: Restatement drifts from CLAUDE.md rule 10; mitigated by conflict_rule deferring to CLAUDE.md

items.title: L2 routing-surface contract
